name: TS Network
summary: A bilingual conversion-focused website promoting high-speed internet and security camera services for homes and businesses across Brownsville and the Texas Valley.
functions: Presents internet and camera plans, checks service availability, captures leads, enables quote requests, and connects customers with online payments and account access.
problem: TS Network needed a professional Spanish-English presence that clearly explained its connectivity and security services while converting local visitors into qualified prospects.
solution: I designed a responsive dark-mode experience with bilingual navigation, interactive service plans, coverage inquiries, direct contact flows, and access to the customer payment portal.
